issue.title: Extract shared account session helpers for sign-out and switch
issue.body:
## Summary

Sign-out / account-switch orchestration is duplicated across Settings and UserSettingsMenu (FluentAPI.signOut, keychain, KV known users, authToken, switchActiveUser). Extract thin service helpers so UI stays presentational.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Shared helpers for sign-out-current-user and switch-to-user (with credential/token checks matching existing behavior)
- [ ] SettingsScreen and UserSettingsMenu call the helpers (no behavior change for users)
- [ ] Unit tests for the helpers covering success, missing token, and multi-account remaining-user path
- [ ] No new generic auth framework / context unless a second pattern already requires it

## Out of scope

Visual redesign of settings menus (#193), account cap UX changes.
